psalm-38-1.verse: O Lord, rebuke me not in Your wrath, And chasten me not in Your burning anger.
psalm-38-1.prayer: Lord, when You correct me, help me receive Your discipline with humility and a willing heart.

psalm-38-2.verse: For Your arrows have sunk deep into me, And Your hand has pressed down on me.
psalm-38-2.prayer: Father, remind me that Your correction comes from love and is meant to draw me closer to You.

psalm-38-3.verse: There is no soundness in my flesh because of Your indignation; There is no health in my bones because of my sin.
psalm-38-3.prayer: Lord, reveal areas of my life that need healing and restoration. Help me turn fully to You.

psalm-38-4.verse: For my iniquities are gone over my head; As a heavy burden they weigh too much for me.
psalm-38-4.prayer: Father, when the weight of sin and failure feels overwhelming, remind me of Your mercy and forgiveness.

psalm-38-5.verse: My wounds grow foul and fester Because of my folly.
psalm-38-5.prayer: Lord, help me recognize the consequences of sin and give me wisdom to walk in obedience.

psalm-38-6.verse: I am bent over and greatly bowed down; I go mourning all day long.
psalm-38-6.prayer: Father, when I feel burdened and discouraged, strengthen me and lift my eyes toward Your hope.

psalm-38-7.verse: For my loins are filled with burning, And there is no soundness in my flesh.
psalm-38-7.prayer: Lord, bring healing to every area of weakness in my life—physically, emotionally, and spiritually.

psalm-38-8.verse: I am benumbed and badly crushed; I groan because of the agitation of my heart.
psalm-38-8.prayer: Father, when I feel exhausted and overwhelmed, renew my strength and sustain me by Your grace.

psalm-38-9.verse: Lord, all my desire is before You; And my sighing is not hidden from You.
psalm-38-9.prayer: Lord, You know every desire and struggle within my heart. Thank You for understanding me completely.

psalm-38-10.verse: My heart throbs, my strength fails me; And the light of my eyes, even that has gone from me.
psalm-38-10.prayer: Father, when my strength fails, remind me that Your power is made perfect in weakness.

psalm-38-11.verse: My loved ones and my friends stand aloof from my plague; And my kinsmen stand afar off.
psalm-38-11.prayer: Lord, when I feel isolated or alone, help me remember that You never leave nor forsake me.

psalm-38-12.verse: Those who seek my life lay snares for me; And those who seek to injure me have threatened destruction, And they devise treachery all day long.
psalm-38-12.prayer: Father, protect me from harmful influences and from those things that seek to draw me away from You.

psalm-38-13.verse: But I, like a deaf man, do not hear; And I am like a mute man who does not open his mouth.
psalm-38-13.prayer: Lord, teach me when to remain silent and when to speak with wisdom and grace.

psalm-38-14.verse: Yes, I am like a man who does not hear, And in whose mouth are no arguments.
psalm-38-14.prayer: Father, help me respond to difficult situations with patience, humility, and trust in You.

psalm-38-15.verse: For I hope in You, O Lord; You will answer, O Lord my God.
psalm-38-15.prayer: Lord, I place my hope in You. Thank You for hearing my prayers and caring for my needs.

psalm-38-16.verse: For I said, “May they not rejoice over me, Who, when my foot slips, would magnify themselves against me.”
psalm-38-16.prayer: Father, keep me from discouragement and help me trust You even when circumstances seem difficult.

psalm-38-17.verse: For I am ready to fall, And my sorrow is continually before me.
psalm-38-17.prayer: Lord, when I stumble, strengthen me and help me continue walking faithfully with You.

psalm-38-18.verse: For I confess my iniquity; I am full of anxiety because of my sin.
psalm-38-18.prayer: Father, thank You for the freedom that comes through confession and repentance. Help me walk honestly before You.

psalm-38-19.verse: But my enemies are vigorous and strong, And many are those who hate me wrongfully.
psalm-38-19.prayer: Lord, give me wisdom when facing opposition and help me respond with faith and integrity.

psalm-38-20.verse: And those who repay evil for good, They oppose me, because I follow what is good.
psalm-38-20.prayer: Father, help me continue pursuing what is right, even when it is difficult.

psalm-38-21.verse: Do not forsake me, O Lord; O my God, do not be far from me!
psalm-38-21.prayer: Lord, stay near to me in every season. Let Your presence be my comfort and strength.

psalm-38-22.verse: Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation!
psalm-38-22.prayer: Father, come quickly to help me. Thank You for being my Savior, my refuge, and my hope.

psalm-38-closing.verse:
Lord, thank You for Your mercy, patience, and faithfulness. When I feel burdened by weakness, failure, or difficult circumstances, help me turn to You with honesty and trust. Strengthen me, restore me, and remind me that Your grace is greater than my shortcomings. Stay near to me, guide my steps, and help me walk faithfully in Your ways. May my hope always remain in You.

In Jesus’ name, Amen. 🙏🏻
